description:
Brand Introduction

Deckiez is a cutting-edge, caffeine-infused pouch brand designed to keep people energized no matter how busy life gets. We’re all about empowering go-getters—from entrepreneurs to athletes to blue-collar workers—by providing them with a healthier, more convenient alternative to energy drinks. Our mission is to fuel your ambition without the crash, sugar, or unnecessary ingredients, and we’re already making waves in popular convenience stores like JACKSONS Stores and Bodega Boise. 

Product Description:

Deckiez caffeine pouches are a fast-acting, sugar-free, and portable energy solution. Each pouch contains 40 mg of caffeine, fortified with essential vitamins like Vitamin C, B12, and Taurine, designed to provide a clean, sustained energy boost. Deckiez is nicotine-free and tobacco-free, making it an ideal product for consumers who enjoy the benefits of caffeine but want to avoid the health risks associated with traditional pouches or energy drinks. With zero sugar and zero carbs, it’s a smart choice for anyone seeking energy without compromise.

USP (Unique Selling Point):

Deckiez offers an unmatched combination of portability, convenience, and health-conscious energy. Our pouches are nicotine and tobacco-free, providing a pure caffeine boost in a form that’s easy to use and transport. Deckiez caters to those with active lifestyles—whether they’re working on the go, pursuing athletic goals, or running a business—making it a standout product in the growing energy market. With 40 mg of caffeine per pouch, users can enjoy energy boosts without sugar crashes or excessive ingredients.

Payment Terms:

Affiliates can earn competitive commissions on each sale referred through their unique links. Payment is typically processed monthly, with detailed reporting on sales and performance provided to affiliates. 

Other Information:

As an affiliate, you’ll receive exclusive access to promotional materials, including sample products for content creation on platforms like TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube. You’ll also have early access to upcoming flavors and new product announcements, giving you an edge in promoting Deckiez to your audience. We’re committed to supporting your efforts, offering guidance on how to optimize your promotions and maximize earnings.
